Class HostStartRequest

java.lang.Object
com.github.copilot.generated.rpc.HostStartRequest
@CopilotExperimental @Generated("copilot-sdk-codegen") public final class HostStartRequest extends Object
Starts a supervised AHP host with at least one explicitly selected transport.

Required inputs are constructor arguments. Optional inputs have fluent setters.

Since:
1.0.0
